Who's behind the door

Simak and Nazia opened it.

Every order still gets the same care it did on day one.

It started in Nazia’s kitchen — the same meals she cooked for her own family, with a few extra containers packed for neighbours who kept asking for more. Simak stepped in to handle the orders and the driving, and word of mouth turned home cooking into meal plans, corporate lunches, and event catering across the Emirates. The kitchen got bigger; the recipes didn’t change.

"We're a brother-sister duo on a mission to make healthy eating effortless across the UAE."
Simak & Nazia — Partners at Maroon Door
